facts.primitive_separation: Damage, native movement driver, custom victim motion, shield cooldown, burn, Fracture, healing, lava consumption, native explosion, temporary terrain, delivery and native lifetime remain separate components.
facts.source_damage_types: No custom DamageType in the closed paths. Direct attacks use native mobAttack; flare/jet use native mobProjectile or anonymous magic; bomb uses native explosion actor/factory/holder selection and native lava contact. Projectile appearance is not a damage-type classification.
facts.healing: Three separate15*float(healthMultiplier) calls at24/26/28; removal count/result does not gate healing; only block consumption locally server-gated; NatureRegen binding remains locked and separate.
facts.charge: Native forward speed/input driver separate from server collision damage; hurttrue gates push then source-null Fracture100.
facts.flare: Direct owned7 damage -> hurttrue+alive burn5/post-effects; else magic7 no burn/post. Native onHit still spawns X/plus jets and discards after direct callback rejects/false. Installed FlareBombDamage10 is not read by these paths.
facts.jets: Caster-based native mobProjectile/getDamage with mutual ally checks; hurttrue burn5 no alive-after-hurt. Null caster magic/getDamage no burn. One delayed scan at-8, native lifetime22, UUID load rules untouched.
facts.lava: Entity impact explode(owner) vs block impact explode(bomb), both power2/NONE; ordinary explosion/placed-fluid native damage/control remain. Lava cleanup can remove replacement lava at saved position; ZERO check is reference identity.
facts.native_callbacks: No research-side events/entities/caches or Stage code. Native repeated stomp samples are retained as repeated requests, with existing native hurt admission deciding results.
facts.native_sequence: Cooldowns decrement per concrete tick, not shared server/NoAI bucket cadence; native goal stop sets cooldowns and magma magazine even without a shot. State enum/flag/phase gates are not numeric candidates.
